topic.title: Spend it all, save 10% or save 20% of a $60,000 salary: which saver are you?

title: Same job, same $60,000 salary. Which saver are you? 💼
description:
Same job, same $60,000 salary: who ends up rich?
One spends it all, one saves 10%, one saves 20%, the savings invested at an assumed 7% a year for 30 years, computed. Returns are assumptions, never promises. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.

lines.text: Same job. Same salary, $60,000. In 30 years, only one of them is a millionaire.
Me? I spend it all. Life is short!
Every year, the whole salary is gone. Retirement savings? Nothing.
I save 10%. That's $500 a month, invested.
At an assumed 7% a year, after 30 years, that's $613,544.
I save 20%, so $1,000 a month. Same job, same salary.
Wait. Just $500 more a month, and the gap is that big?
So, which one are you? Remember...
